candidates_considered_and_rejected.why_not_sufficient: Self-describes as benchmark_type='external_analyst_gold', validation_mode_for_existing_runs='RETROSPECTIVE_GOLD_VALIDATION'. Its own scope_statement explicitly states it is 'NOT derived from or copied from docs/audit_artifacts/regression_label_authority_audit_v0.1.2.1.json (that file's own APPROVED_GOLD count remains zero and is untouched by this benchmark)'. This is precisely the kind of retrospective/diagnostic benchmark artifact this task warns is NOT automatically acceptance authority -- it is an internally-created (or external-analyst-authored) benchmark used for a retrospective validation exercise, never presented to or signed off by John. This was the file treated as 'Gold' throughout the prior v0.1.3 session for the 61.0317% figure -- that figure is therefore a HISTORICAL_INTERNAL_DIAGNOSTIC_RESULT, not a JOHN_ACCEPTANCE_GOLD_RESULT.

This IS a genuine John-approval REQUEST document (Sections A-E present explicit checkboxes for John to approve/reject Alpha Gold, Main Conflict Gold, and a Final Decision). However every checkbox in the file is UNCHECKED (□), the Comments field is blank, the Date field is blank, and 'Reviewer: John' has no accompanying signature or decision marked. It was never signed. Additionally, its own PROPOSED Gold table (Section A: e.g. MSFT=[A101,A102,A304], TSM=[A103,A304]) does not even match alpha_conflict_gold_benchmark_v1.json's numbers (MSFT and TSM each carry a different 6-alpha set there) -- confirming these are two separate, unreconciled proposals, neither of which was ever approved.

Concerns John's Item 10 review of RUN-ID freshness/ticker-consistency and artifact completeness for the v0.1.2.1 six-run set -- not an approval of Alpha-detection or Main-Conflict Gold labels. It also references a DIFFERENT six run IDs (v0.1.2.1-era, e.g. NVDA=a8d47429...) than the six FINAL_FRESH_SELECTED v0.1.3 runs (e.g. NVDA=57d7b4c4...) this task and the whole prior v0.1.3 session actually used -- it is not even fresh-run-consistent with the current baseline.

Its own selected_runs.status field reads 'NO_CURRENT_VALID_SEMANTIC_BASELINE', with an explicit note that the only fresh v0.1.2.1 runs available at the time failed semantic execution health -- this index is stale and does not reference the current six FINAL_FRESH_SELECTED v0.1.3 runs at all.

A well-reasoned ENGINEERING-side proposed adjudication, explicitly performed before inspecting production outputs -- but it is a proposal awaiting John's decision via the approval sheet's Section B checkboxes (also left blank), not itself an approval.

This IS genuinely John-approved (2026-08-11, status=approved_gating, confirmed for all six tickers per main_conflict_gold_adjudication_v0.1.2.1_r2.json's own citation) -- but it approves the Entity Alpha Exposure GATING seed specifically, not Alpha-detection expectations or Main-Conflict Gold labels. Not sufficient authority for this task's specific comparison.
